output: To reset your ATM PIN: 1) Visit any bank ATM with your debit card, 2) Select 'Forgot PIN' or 'PIN Generation', 3) Enter your registered mobile number, 4) You'll receive an OTP on your mobile, 5) Enter the OTP and set a new 4-digit PIN. Alternatively, use NetBanking → Cards → Reset PIN option.

instruction: What is the UPI transaction limit?
output: UPI transaction limits are: Per transaction limit is ₹1,00,000. Daily limit varies by bank but typically ranges from ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,00,000. Some banks may set lower caps. Please check with your bank for exact limits.

instruction: How can I block my debit card?
output: To block a lost or stolen debit card: Call our 24x7 helpline at 1800-XXX-XXXX immediately. Or use the Mobile Banking App → Cards → Block/Hotlist. You can also SMS BLOCK<space>last 4 digits to 9876543210. A new card will be issued within 5-7 working days.

अपना एटीएम पिन रीसेट करने के लिए: 1) अपने डेबिट कार्ड के साथ किसी भी बैंक एटीएम पर जाएं, 2) 'पिन भूल गए' या 'पिन जनरेशन' चुनें, 3) पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर दर्ज करें, 4) आपको मोबाइल पर ओटीपी प्राप्त होगा, 5) ओटीपी दर्ज करें और नया 4 अंकों का पिन सेट करें।
यूपीआई लेनदेन सीमा: प्रति लेनदेन सीमा ₹1,00,000 है। दैनिक सीमा बैंक के अनुसार भिन्न होती है लेकिन आमतौर पर ₹1,00,000 से ₹2,00,000 तक होती है। सटीक सीमा के लिए अपने बैंक से संपर्क करें।

instruction: What is the annual fee for credit cards?
output: Credit card annual fee structure: Classic cards: ₹500-₹1,000 annually, Gold cards: ₹2,000-₹5,000, Platinum/Premium: ₹5,000-₹50,000. Fee is waived if annual spending exceeds minimum threshold (usually 4x the fee). First year often free on new cards.

To get your account statement: 1) NetBanking: Login → Account → Statement → Select period → Download PDF/Excel, 2) Mobile App: Accounts → Tap account → Statement, 3) Branch: Submit written request, 4) Email: Send request to customer.service@bank.com. Statements available for last 10 years.

Minimum Average Balance (MAB) requirements: Urban branches - ₹10,000 for savings accounts, Semi-urban - ₹5,000, Rural - ₹2,000. Zero balance accounts available for students, senior citizens, and basic savings accounts.

instruction: Can you send me OTP for login?
output: I cannot generate or send OTPs. OTPs are automatically sent by the bank's secure system to your registered mobile number when you attempt to login or perform sensitive operations. If you're not receiving OTPs, please contact customer care at 1800-XXX-XXXX.

Fund transfer timings: NEFT - 24x7 available in 30-minute batches, RTGS - Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 7am-1pm, IMPS - 24x7 instant transfer, UPI - 24x7 instant. Processing time: IMPS/UPI immediate, NEFT up to 2 hours, RTGS 30 minutes.

To update registered mobile number: Visit your home branch with: 1) Account passbook/debit card, 2) Valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport), 3) Filled mobile number update form. OTP verification required. Process completes in 24 hours. Cannot be done online for security reasons.

Home loan prepayment terms: Floating rate loans - No prepayment penalty. Fixed rate loans - 2-3% penalty on prepaid amount during lock-in period (usually first 3 years). After lock-in, prepayment charges waived.

Request new cheque book: 1) NetBanking: Services → Cheque Book Request → Select account → Submit, 2) Mobile App: Services → Cheque Book, 3) Call customer care, 4) Visit branch. Delivery in 5-7 working days via courier.
